core_positioning: An explicit finite-support, real-replay audit with signed oracle-interface comparisons. General prediction/decision mismatch and latent metric repair have clear prior art. Novelty requires the actual reproducible empirical findings, not the elementary identities.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: Positive mean Mis proves that more accurate predictions hurt decisions.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: Mis is residual regret after true-future substitution; reversal requires paired forecast error reduction and utility loss at the same frozen interface.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: Predictive errors harm only when objective mismatch exists in an agreeing direction.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: With U=(1,0), true features=(0,1), predicted features=(1,0), and maximizing negative features: Mis=0, Pred=1, Reg=1.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: Mis and Pred partition regret into nonnegative causal sources.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: Pred can be negative and cancel Mis. Algebra is not by itself a causal mediation identification result.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: Elite means are convex mixtures of cached candidate utility.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: Executed means are new actions and require replay. U(a)=a^2, actions +/-1, mean 0 is a counterexample.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: Leverage is the maximum damage relative to the native baseline.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: Native-baseline harmful headroom is U(baseline)-min U; leverage bounds arbitrary selector pairs and can be larger.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: A measured bound violation falsifies a general mechanism prediction.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: Under fixed complete support the bound is an identity implication; check coverage, continuation, randomness and metrics when apparent violations arise.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: Recorded branch extrema bound random-environment expected harm.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: A realized cache is descriptive. Expected-utility claims need repeated branches and simultaneous uncertainty bounds.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: Thirty independent states ensure statistical power.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: Power depends on effect size, variance and design. Episode clusters determine independent units; preregister minimum useful effects.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: Lower visual goal MSE is higher forecast fidelity.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: Goal cost compares an outcome to the goal; forecast error compares a prediction to the real future for the same action.

mathematical_corrections.proposal_claim: Mis dominance predicts superiority of scorer repair.
mathematical_corrections.replacement: P3 needs directly compared feasible repairs with held-out calibration, frozen bank, paired absolute utilities and controls.

pending_empirical_requirements: E0: include only complete matched candidate/replay support; report exclusions and native-versus-added-planner status.
E1: distinguish residual regret from fidelity-induced reversal; use native-interface matched fidelity and actual utility, not goal cost.
E2: use upper-bound checks as support consistency checks; small cached bounds are not population safety claims.
E3: directly compare scorer and prediction repairs after separate calibration and evaluation.
E4: independent held-out task or system replication remains an empirical requirement, not supplied by theory or source review.
limitations: Only read scopes listed per source were verified.
LENS full text inaccessible through ordinary forum/PDF routes; official API abstract was available.
No literature results imported into our experimental tables.
The elementary total-variation and baseline headroom bounds are not presented as novel mathematical results.
